title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 6: Space Exploration Technologies Rises Despite First Lockup Expiration
excerpt: Today, Aug. 6, 2026, insiders gained eligibility to sell 911.5 million shares as the rocket maker's stock climbed 6.14% despite float unlock concerns.
content_html:
Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX), a rocket launch, spacecraft manufacturing, and satellite broadband services provider, closed at $114.92, up 6.14%. The stock surged after its first major lockup expiration made about 911.5 million insider shares eligible for sale. Investors are watching potential selling pressure and added float. Trading volume reached 252.4M shares, coming in about 109% above its three-month average of 121.0M shares. Space Exploration Technologies IPO'd in 2026 and has fallen 29% since going public.

How the markets moved today

The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) fell 0.16% to 7,711, and the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) slipped 0.06% to 26,348. Among aerospace and defense and launch-services peers, Rocket Lab (NASDAQ:RKLB) closed at $75.67, up 1.14%, while AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ:ASTS) finished at $67.36, down 1.49%, reflecting mixed trading across space-linked names after the float unlock in Space Exploration Technologies.

What this means for investors

It was supposed to be a high-risk day for SpaceX investors as the number of tradable SPCX shares more than doubled due to the company's first major lockup expiration, but the stock rose 6%. It is virtually impossible to pinpoint the exact reason why this was the case, but it somewhat quells a significant fear that faced the stock previously.

S3 Partners believe short interest on the stock's tradable float could be as high as 36%, so it is entirely possible that some of today's rise came from covering short positions after SPCX stock dipped over 10% following earnings on Tuesday. Regardless of what's moving the stock, today's resilience is encouraging and serves as a reminder to prioritize the stock's actual operations and long-term vision over short-term news items like today's "big" lock-up expiration headlines.

Should SpaceX hit management guidance for $100 billion in ARR by the end of the year, its $1.5 trillion market cap wouldn't be as outlandish as it may seem at first blush. That said, interested investors would be wise to make small purchases over time, rather than going "all-in" on the company at any point in the near future. Volatility will likely persist.

火箭发射、航天器制造和卫星宽带服务提供商太空探索技术公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）收于 114.92 美元，上涨 6.14%。 该股在第一次主要禁售期到期后飙升，约 9.115 亿股内部股票有资格出售。 投资者正在关注潜在的抛售压力和增加的流通量。 交易量达到 2.524 亿股，比三个月平均水平 1.21 亿股高出约 109%。 Space Exploration Technologies 于 2026 年首次公开募股，自上市以来已下跌 29%。

今日市场走势如何

标准普尔 500 指数 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) 下跌 0.16%，至 7,711 点；纳斯达克综合指数 (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) 下跌 0.06%，至 26,348 点。 在航空航天、国防和发射服务同行中，Rocket Lab (纳斯达克股票代码：RKLB) 收于 75.67 美元，上涨 1.14%，而 AST SpaceMobile (纳斯达克股票代码：ASTS) 收于 67.36 美元，下跌 1.49%，反映出太空探索技术公司浮动解锁后，与太空相关的公司的交易涨跌互现。

这对投资者意味着什么

这对 SpaceX 投资者来说本应是高风险的一天，因为由于该公司首次重大禁售期到期，可交易的 SPCX 股票数量增加了一倍多，但该股却上涨了 6%。 实际上不可能查明出现这种情况的确切原因，但这在一定程度上平息了该股此前面临的重大担忧。

S3 Partners 认为，该股可交易流通量的空头利息可能高达 36%，因此今天的上涨部分完全有可能来自回补空头头寸，此前 SPCX 股价在周二公布财报后下跌了 10% 以上。 不管是什么推动了股票的走势，今天的韧性令人鼓舞，并提醒人们优先考虑股票的实际运营和长期愿景，而不是像今天的“大”禁售期到期头条新闻这样的短期新闻。

如果 SpaceX 到今年年底的 ARR 达到 1000 亿美元的管理层指导，那么其 1.5 万亿美元的市值就不会像乍一看那么奇怪。 也就是说，感兴趣的投资者明智的做法是随着时间的推移进行小额购买，而不是在不久的将来的任何时候“全力投资”该公司。 波动可能会持续下去。
